base_member_text: Comment L116 records a known bug (loop bounds should be J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc) but the code at L108-109 still loops J=1,Nloc-1, I=1,Mloc-1 — i.e. ETAT and DU/DV are not computed on the last row/column in this version
ELSEIF(SHOW_BREAKING .OR. WAVEMAKER_VIS) branch at L144-146 is empty — ETAT needed for breaking is computed unconditionally at L118, so the branch body may have been moved out; intent not stated
b2 used in omega_1 (L373-374) is not declared locally and its relation to Beta_1/Beta_2 comes from GLOBAL (cross-file)
Loop indices I,J and neighbor-rank variables n_west,n_east,n_suth,n_nrth, MPI_PROC_NULL come from USE GLOBAL (cross-file)

U1p/V1p (L281-290) use Uxx,Vxy,DUxx,DVxy computed only by second-order DERIVATIVE_XX/XY (L86-92) — header comment L66-67 says derivative_xx_high was changed to second order per Harris suggestion; the _HIGH variants defined in derivatives.f90 are not called here
EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L244) and DERIVATIVE_* are defined in other files (cross-file)

audit_member_text: Lines 379-380 compare abs(omega) against VorticityMax but then store signed omega rather than abs(omega). A new negative extremum can make VorticityMax negative, after which later positive magnitudes trivially exceed it; the stored field therefore does not consistently represent a maximum magnitude.
dispositions.rationale: VorticityMax: abs(omega) 비교 후 signed omega(I,J) 저장(L379-380) → 음의 극값이 VorticityMax 를 음수화, 최대 크기장 부정확. 진단출력 결함. base 미검출.

audit_member_text: ETAT is assigned only for I=1..Mloc-1 and J=1..Nloc-1 at lines 108-118, while it is consumed over Ibeg..Iend and Jbeg..Jend at lines 298-328. Whether every consumed element is assigned in this call depends on the GLOBAL bounds; no local range assertion establishes that Iend<=Mloc-1 and Jend<=Nloc-1.
Ut and Vt divide by DT at lines 136-137 without a local nonzero/positive-DT guard; safety depends on an external timestep invariant.
